content.rationale: Undo takes the marker at pos-1 by the inverse its kind records — reverting the entries newest first for a recording or removal, recording the removal of the created change for a creation — and records the reverts it made; a position at zero refuses, and a revert that refuses partway refuses the whole undo, leaving the state as it began and naming the refusing entry (the refusal semantics of `qxmzpupt`). The position moves one back (kpptprql), so the next undo takes the previous operation.
